raw_site_text: four districts encompassing 36 communities: Nsawam-Adoagyiri, Ayensuano, Akuapem North and Upper West Akyem
justification: The study was conducted in four named districts near Accra (Nsawam-Adoagyiri, Ayensuano, Akuapem North, Upper West Akyem), all of which lie in Ghana's Eastern Region.
note: Region assigned from the named districts by geographic knowledge; 'Upper West' and 'Greater Accra' in units_found are not study sites (Upper West Akyem is an Eastern Region district; Accra is only the IPA office).
